summary: Pull request intake reviews the first ready head after a positively marked creation receipt, without treating legacy head-less observations or unmarked receipts as new reviews

replay.detail: No automatic replay. An explicit replay or refresh marks retained positively marked receipts that were never observed; unmarked receipts are never inferred.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Receipt, observation and subscription request formats are unchanged. Projected receipt-only resources carry facts.receipt_only=true until observation; existing projections do not change automatically. Legacy head-less observations and unmarked receipts remain review baselines.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the earlier head-less receipt behavior.
